diagnostics.message: google_project_service.project_services enables APIs on local.project.project_id, which is the newly created google_project.project when project_create is true. The graph has no dependency on the project resource, but APIs cannot be enabled until the project exists.

google_access_context_manager_service_perimeter_resource.bridge builds its resource name from local.project.number, which comes from google_project.project when the project is created. It must wait for the project to exist before adding the project to the VPC-SC perimeter.

google_access_context_manager_service_perimeter_resource.standard builds its resource name from local.project.number, which comes from google_project.project when the project is created. It must wait for the project to exist before adding the project to the VPC-SC perimeter.

google_compute_shared_vpc_service_project.shared_vpc_service sets service_project to local.project.project_id, which is the newly created google_project.project when project_create is true. The project must exist before it can be attached as a Shared VPC service project.

google_essential_contacts_contact.contact sets parent to projects/local.project.project_id, which is the newly created google_project.project when project_create is true. The project must exist before contacts can be attached.

google_logging_project_exclusion.logging-exclusion sets project to local.project.project_id, which is the newly created google_project.project when project_create is true. The project must exist before logging exclusions can be created.

google_monitoring_monitored_project.primary sets name to local.project.project_id, which is the newly created google_project.project when project_create is true. The project must exist before it can be added to a metrics scope.

google_org_policy_policy.default sets its policy parent/name from local.project.project_id, which is the newly created google_project.project when project_create is true. The project must exist before project-level organization policies can be created.

google_project_iam_audit_config.default sets project to local.project.project_id, which is the newly created google_project.project when project_create is true. The project must exist before audit log configuration can be applied.

google_project_iam_custom_role.roles sets project to local.project.project_id, which is the newly created google_project.project when project_create is true. The project must exist before custom roles can be created in it.

google_resource_manager_lien.lien sets parent to projects/local.project.number, which comes from google_project.project when project_create is true. The project must exist before a project-deletion lien can be created.

google_tags_tag_binding.binding sets parent from local.project.number, which comes from google_project.project when project_create is true. The project must exist before tag bindings can be applied to it.

google_tags_tag_key.default sets parent to projects/local.project.project_id, which is the newly created google_project.project when project_create is true. The project must exist before tag keys can be created under it.
